The problem: English AirDrop copy on the China storefront

AirDrop-forward listings fail on the China App Store in predictable ways when only en-US is filled:

  • Robotic literal translation — machine output that says 空投 for AirDrop or mixes English brand terms with awkward hanzi
  • Over-claiming system AirDrop — listing promises full AirDrop integration when your app only exports a file that users must send manually from the Share sheet
  • Confused with Share sheet or Handoff — description talks about "sharing" generically when screenshots show the AirDrop avatar row, or mixes 接力 Handoff language with 隔空投送 nearby send
  • Untranslated screenshot badges — overlay lines like "Send with AirDrop", "Share nearby", or "Nearby sharing" remain English on zh-Hans gallery frames
  • Keyword field still en-US — buyers search 隔空投送, 附近分享, or 无线传文件; an English-only keyword row misses China Search intent

Better zh-Hans listing copy helps nearby-transfer buyers understand your wireless-send story before install. It does not replace MultipeerConnectivity implementation, AirDrop entitlements, or Apple's review decisions.

AirDrop-specific vocabulary — what translates differently in zh-Hans

Nearby-transfer listings use terms general localization guides rarely cover. zh-Hans copy should reflect how Chinese App Store readers evaluate wireless send features:

隔空投送 (AirDrop) vs 附近分享 (nearby sharing)

Apple's Chinese system UI uses 隔空投送 for AirDrop. 附近分享 fits when your marketing says nearby sharing or wireless transfer without always naming the AirDrop brand. Pick the term buyers recognize on each screenshot frame — an AirDrop avatar row needs 隔空投送-friendly phrasing; a generic proximity badge may use 附近分享 when accurate.

Device-accurate claims

If your app sends to nearby iPhone and iPad but not Mac, zh-Hans copy should say 向附近的 iPhone 和 iPad 隔空投送 — not 向 Mac 隔空投送 unless a Mac target exists. AppLocale rewrites from your stated device matrix and English claims; we do not invent platform support your Connect listing cannot deliver.

Do not imply system AirDrop you do not ship

If your app prepares a file and opens the system share UI — where the user picks AirDrop themselves — listing copy should say 导出后可通过隔空投送发送, not 内置隔空投送 when you do not present the AirDrop sheet inside your UI. Over-claiming invites review questions and refund requests from China buyers.

FAQ

Does adding AirDrop in my app auto-translate my China listing?

No. AirDrop UI and nearby-transfer code control in-app behavior — they do not create or fill a Simplified Chinese localization row. Empty or English zh-Hans fields mean China buyers see en-US fallback even when screenshots show Send with AirDrop in English.

How is AirDrop listing copy different from Share sheet or Handoff copy?

AirDrop listing copy markets wireless send to nearby devices — 隔空投送 and 附近分享. Share sheet copy markets the system Share UI (Copy Link, Save Image). Handoff copy markets session resume across devices (接力). Different buyer story, different zh-Hans vocabulary.

What listing fields does AppLocale rewrite for AirDrop apps?

Paste-ready zh-Hans copy for title, subtitle, keywords, description, promotional text when included, and screenshot overlay or caption lines such as AirDrop, Send with AirDrop, Share nearby, Nearby sharing, 隔空投送, and 附近分享 — rewritten from your English originals.

Does AppLocale implement MultipeerConnectivity or peer-sharing SDKs?

No. We deliver Connect listing metadata copy only. MultipeerConnectivity, Bonjour discovery, CoreBluetooth proximity, and custom P2P transfer code are outside scope.

How should zh-Hans copy describe nearby sharing without over-claiming system AirDrop?

Match what your binary actually offers — native AirDrop sheet, custom nearby transfer, or export-then-AirDrop — using 隔空投送 and 附近分享 accurately. AppLocale rewrites from your English claims and device matrix; we do not invent transfer flows your app cannot deliver.
